meta.title: Optimize unit test timeouts
meta.body_summary: Reduce mock setTimeout delays from 60s to 5s in timeout.test.ts to speed up unit test execution.

perf_labels.notes: Single-file, 8-line timeout reduction; merged within 10 minutes after non-blocking bot reviews; no human feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 8 changed lines, this is an extremely small edit by absolute volume. It fits a trivial test optimization PR that can be merged immediately with no risk.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review feedback; the Greptile bot provided a non-blocking summary and the Vercel bot reported an unrelated deployment failure.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce mock setTimeout delays from 60s to 5s to optimize unit test execution speed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Trivial parameter change in a test file; requires no benchmark or domain expertise and merges with zero friction.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/data-source/tests/unit/adapters/timeout.test.ts, changed mock setTimeout delays from 60000 (60 seconds) to 5000 (5 seconds) across four test cases. Uses vi.advanceTimersByTime to simulate elapsed time and still verify timeout behavior.
change_trajectory: Single commit aa5449a: replaced four occurrences of 60000 with 5000 while keeping the rest of the test logic intact.

review_signals.summary: Greptile bot posted a PR summary noting the test timeout reduction and that tests still properly verify timeout behavior for various database adapters; no inline comments.
Vercel bot reported a deployment failure for buster-web, likely unrelated to the test timeout change.

Vercel bot commented on deployment status.
Maintainer merged after ~10 minutes with no additional feedback.
